授業概要
In this course, students will learn the essence of the quantitative methodology of social science. In the second term, we study social surveys and statistical analysis (multi-variable analysis, causal inference, and computational social science).

授業計画
In Methodology of Social Science III and VII, students will read literature on social surveys, statistical analysis, and computational social science.
(Students also must take Methodology of Social Science IV and VIII.)
The literature will be determined by our interests.
In this course, we will cover some of the topics listed below:
Sociology and Social Surveys / Survey Ethics Issues / Hypotheses and Survey Design / Hypothesis and Test / Random Sampling / Non-probability Sampling / Statistical Inference / Statistical Test / Description and Basic Analysis of quantitative data / Description and Basic Analysis of Categorical Data
Quantitative Approaches in Sociology / Correlation Coefficients and Causality /
Estimation Methods and Interpretation of Regression Analysis / Regression analysis with dummy variables / Cross Tables and Various Types of Analysis (Cramer's V, Chi-square Test) / Loglinear Analysis / Analysis of variance / Methods of Analysis of Discrete Variables / Binomial Logistic Regression Analysis / Multinomial and ordinal logistic regression analysis / Poisson Regression Analysis / Event History Analysis / Latent Class Analysis /Matching by Propensity Score
